owner_calls.question: Keep Chafa and Maya Lopez? Chafa is the first Choctaw, an ancestor who lived centuries before Maya; they never meet, and Maya only hears her legend and sees her in visions (blood tie never met, visions are not events). But the MCU wiki says Chafa's power echoes down her line and Maya channels Chafa and the other ancestors to defeat Kingpin, which could count as huge consequences for Maya.
options: Keep (Chafa's echoed power shapes Maya's defeat of Kingpin)
Drop (blood tie never met, contact only in visions)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom: Bonnie tells young Maya the legend of Chafa (Echo#1); Maya sees visions of Chafa, Lowak, Tuklo and Chula; in Echo#5 Maya channels her ancestors, including Chafa, to defeat Kingpin. Chafa appears to Maya only in flashbacks, sculpture, vision and illusion.
